description: Planning & forecasting directly in Power BI accoPLANNING is a powerful visual tool that allows you to plan, budget, and forecast directly within Microsoft Power BI – all without switching between systems or needing separate software This version of accoPLANNING is our Preview version, This version is a Quality assurance version, shared with Partners and select customers, who is participating in testing a non-published version before it is transferred to accoPLANNING Professional This version is not for end-users Find the most recent version of accoPLANNING here: accoPLANNING Professional Key Features • Writeback Functionality: Enter and save data (like forecasts or budgets) Directly into your database from Power BI • Seamless Planning: Manage projects, financial plans, and forecasts inside the same reports your team already use. • Easy Integration: Built on Power BI, no need to redefine your already existing datamodels • Real-time updates: See the effect of any changes immediately in your dashboards • Customizable: Tailor the layout and input options to fit your organization’s needs Find a list of and description of the features that makes accoPLANNING a stand-out tool here: accoPLANNING Features Why Choose accoPLANNING?
